name: Pinecone
subtitle: Managed vector database
creator: Edo Liberty
description: A database built for embeddings, the lists of numbers AI models use to represent meaning. It finds the most similar items quickly, which powers semantic search and chat over documents.

languages.youWrite: SDKs for Python, TypeScript, Java, Go and .NET

codeSamples.label: Python
codeSamples.code:
from pinecone import Pinecone

pc = Pinecone(api_key="YOUR_API_KEY")
index = pc.Index("docs")

index.upsert(vectors=[{"id": "doc-1", "values": embedding, "metadata": {"title": "Refunds"}}])

results = index.query(vector=question_embedding, top_k=3, include_metadata=True)
for match in results.matches:
    print(match.metadata["title"], match.score)

cons: Postgres with pgvector may be enough
